name: Image + Text Split
description: The surface is divided into a clean image field and a clean type field. The most legible and most reproducible structure, and the safest choice when the message carries information that must survive at small scale.
spacing: A hard division between the two fields with no overlap. Internal spacing within the text field follows a single consistent step so the block reads as one structured unit.
responsive_behavior: The split ratio shifts between the square and portrait formats while the division stays on a grid line. The image field never drops below forty percent or the composition loses its anchor.
